analyst.summary: Firstsource had a strong FY26 - crossing $1 billion in revenue for the first time with profit growing faster than sales - and the underlying return ratios (mid-teens ROE, high-teens ROCE) are healthy for a business-services company. But management's own guidance for the coming year points to slower growth (10-13%) and only modest margin improvement, some of the recent growth has come from acquisitions rather than pure organic demand, and the stock has fallen sharply over the past year as markets worry about AI eventually automating the call-center and back-office work this company sells. We see this as a fundamentally solid, fairly-valued Hold rather than a name to add to on weakness or to exit outright.
